studios.name: SoMa
studios.description: Clayroom's combined ceramics and woodworking studio, offering wheel throwing and lathe turning classes and memberships under one roof.
studios.imageAlt: A student turning wood on a lathe at Clayroom SoMa

studios.name: Potrero Hill
studios.description: A 7,000 sq ft neighborhood studio with 53 pottery wheels, 2 slab rollers, 2 extruders, 35 dipping glazes, a spray booth, 7 kilns, and a glaze mixing room with natural light throughout.
studios.imageAlt: Hands centering clay on a pottery wheel at Clayroom Potrero Hill

studios.name: San Mateo
studios.description: A community studio in the Bay Meadows development with 17-foot floor-to-ceiling windows, giving the space natural light and an open feel while you work.
studios.address: 3050 South Delaware Street, Suite 100, San Mateo, CA 94403
studios.imageAlt: Bright, window-lined interior of the Clayroom San Mateo studio

studios.name: Oakland Temescal
studios.description: A community-centered ceramics studio in Temescal offering classes and events for every skill level, from a first time at the wheel to advanced glaze work.
studios.imageAlt: A handmade wooden bench built at Clayroom Oakland Temescal

studios.name: West Oakland
studios.description: A two-story, 5,700 sq ft studio in Prescott Market offering both cone 5 mid-fire and cone 10 reduction firing under one roof.
studios.imageAlt: A kiln in the Clayroom West Oakland studio

studios.name: Hayes Valley
studios.description: Clayroom's newest studio, combining ceramics and woodworking in the heart of Hayes Valley. Opening soon.
